runs.name: Alfa Laval AB; Nasdaq Stockholm ALFA, OTC ADR ALFVY, SEC CIKs 0000863344 and 0000713064 with ADR forms only, read from its own annual reports; heat transfer, separation and fluid handling in Energy, Food & Water and Marine; Fives Cryogenics and NRG Marine 2025
runs.entry: Price **SEK 576.40** a share (Nasdaq Stockholm close 2026-10-16 through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged; price and every figure in SEK, ADR ratio not read in a filing). Shares **413,326,315**, one class, no treasury shares (Annual & Sustainability Report 2025, Management Report p. 12; checked against the Q2 2026 interim report of 2026-07-21); cap **SEK 238,241M**. Sovereign **3.119%** (Sveriges Riksbank SEGVB10YC, Swedish government 10-year, 2026-10-15; the Riksbank publishes no longer krona series, a CONVENTION of the run). No annual report filed with the SEC; documents read by date in place of accessions: the Annual & Sustainability Report 2025 (signed 2026-03-23, EY report 2026-03-24), the Q2 2026 interim report, the annual reports 2017 to 2019 and 2021 to 2024 (2020 from the ten-year overview and the 2021 comparatives), the year-end releases 2016 to 2025; operating cash 2025 SEK 9,166M cross-checked between the ten-year overview and the cash flow statement. The brief's stated departures: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's business, Risk Management and Management Report sections; rivals the report names, the 2025 report naming none so the 2021 lists used (a CONVENTION of the run), SPX FLOW and Dover (the segment holding SWEP) read as the SEC filers, nineteen named rivals including GEA flagged as not SEC filers; the Stockholm price. **Q1 IN**: products and service (30.4% of 2025 sales) in three technologies where the filer states No. 1 positions, adjusted operating margin 15.6% to 17.7% over 2016 to 2025. **Q2 IN**: no part above half, Food & Water 35.6% of five-year division profit decides with Energy 32.8% and Marine 31.6% read beside it; return on all capital including goodwill 15.3% to 23.9% over the decade; titanium pricing linked to purchase prices; SPX FLOW 5.3% to 8.6% operating margins 2017 to 2021 and the Dover segment below Alfa Laval in eight of nine years; Food & Water's margin narrowing 16.7% (2022) to 15.1% (2025) carried as the evidence against. **Q3 weighs for**; **Q4 weighs for** (ten balance sheets, no confusion or suspicion; adjusted EBITA and EBITDA ratios against); **Q5 integrity IN** (misses stated plainly, no guidance); **Q6 undecided** (retention passes, 2021 to 2022 buybacks at about SEK 326 below the range bottom; Fives Cryogenics SEK 9,210M for SEK 421M pro forma profit, pay on sales growth including bought growth with no capital charge). **Q7 OUT on the floor**: owner cash 2021 to 2025 SEK 6,608M a year maintenance-only, SEK 5,380M after all capital spending, SEK 1,920M after purchases; purchases SEK 17,300M over five years, a serial acquirer on the organic pair at 9.27%; net debt SEK 12,530M at 2026-06-30, leases charged in owner cash and left out of net debt (a CONVENTION of the run); value range **SEK 482.23 to 1,066.26** all-equity against SEK 576.40, 2.6% to 5.3% at the price on every case, no case earns the floor; fair **SEK 187.17 all-equity** (SEK 211.78 equity-only; SEK 199.87 with leases as debt); alert `ALFVY-v5-fair` armed by hand on ALFA.ST in SEK because the fold tool arms in USD. Q8 to Q10 not reached. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: 315 asbestos suits pending; SEK 7,569M of debt due in 2026 against SEK 7,566M undrawn credit; owner cash SEK 1,371M in 2022. Contamination declared by the analyst: one filtered `Test Runs/` listing for the name before the file existed, returning nothing; the FLR commit subjects, the AYI and ARCB folder names in git status and memory index lines; none used. A process slip declared: the acceptance test run after, not before, the Q3 commit, PASS. Commits d15a9a2f (template) to e2b54335 (box, close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` clean; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 66 ids, no missing id, no E-id, 79 fragments, three flags verified clean by hand (regex captures of the run's own prose beside M2005-017, M2000-014 and M2009-081, whose quoted fragments are in their rows): **no slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) leases under IFRS 16 against Q7's finance and operating lease split; (2) the sovereign for a currency outside the protocol's table when the issuer publishes nothing past ten years; (3) rivals the report names when the latest report names none, and a parent's mixed segment as the SEC filer; (4) how growth spending moves inside the ten years when (c) and (e) apply together; (5) organic sales growth used as owner-cash growth, inflation included; (6) the largest part deciding among three near-equal parts; (7) Q6's retention test against intrinsic value over a past span. Could not get: GEA and the non-filing rivals' figures, the 2020 annual report, exact organic growth for 2024 and 2025, customer or supplier evidence.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (Alfa Laval AB; Nasdaq Stockholm ALFA, ADR ALFVY; heat transfer, separation and fluid handling in Energy, Food & Water and Marine, read from its own annual reports). Q1 IN on No. 1 positions in three technologies and service near a third of sales, margins 15.6% to 17.7% through the decade; Q2 IN on Food & Water (35.6% of five-year division profit, the three parts near equal), returns on all capital 15.3% to 23.9%, SPX FLOW and the Dover segment below it, Food & Water's narrowing margin the evidence against; Q3 and Q4 weigh for, Q5 integrity IN, Q6 undecided on high-priced purchases (Fives Cryogenics) and pay on bought growth. Q7: a serial acquirer on the organic pair, owner cash SEK 6,608M maintenance-only, value SEK 482.23 to 1,066.26 all-equity at the Riksbank 10-year 3.119% against SEK 576.40, 2.6% to 5.3% at the price, no case earns the floor; fair SEK 187.17 all-equity (SEK 211.78 equity-only), alert armed on ALFA.ST in SEK. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: IFRS 16 leases, a sovereign past the protocol's table, rivals when the latest report names none, growth spending under (c) with (e), organic sales growth as owner-cash growth, three near-equal parts, Q6's retention test against intrinsic value.
